response.sql:
SELECT t.observstation, o.lunarstage, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count
FROM telescopes t
JOIN observatories o ON o.observstation = t.observstation
WHERE t.bandusagepct >= 47.6
GROUP BY t.observstation, o.lunarstage
ORDER BY telescope_count DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Ties in count are broken arbitrarily, since the request gives no tie-break order, so the top 10 may vary among tied rows.
Telescopes with NULL bandusagepct are excluded by the >= 47.6 filter, and rows with NULL lunarstage are kept as their own group.
